style_lock.substyle_prompt_phrase: hand-painted gouache and watercolor, warm paper texture, gentle expressions
style_lock.render_medium: hand-painted gouache and watercolor on textured paper
style_lock.line_treatment: soft pencil contour with painterly gouache edges, visible brushwork, no hard digital lines
style_lock.color_system: muted warm colors, earth tones, soft ochre, gentle greens, faded indigo, warm cream paper base
style_lock.texture_behavior: visible paper grain, subtle gouache texture, hand-painted imperfections
style_lock.composition_bias: simple framed scenes, kamishibai stage-like border, one clear focal point per card, breathing space, Japanese educational storytelling layout
style_lock.style_drift_to_avoid: digital anime rendering, glossy CG, photorealism, action manga, moe aesthetics, Western picture-book gloss
style_lock.seed_image_style_raw: kamishibai paper theater, hand-painted gouache and watercolor, warm paper texture, Japanese educational storytelling, muted colors, simple framed scenes, gentle expressions

positive_style_anchors: simple framed scenes with clear focal point
negative_style_anchors: avoid glossy CG or vector art feel
reference_anchor_policy: same face and hair identity from reference
describe the host lightly and rely on the reference first

continuity_governance.variation_rule: keep continuity anchors but change the line-specific semantic action, object, or story beat

allowed_location_families: Japanese neighborhood parks and walking paths
community-center or clinic waiting spaces only when the line truly needs them
wardrobe_rules: practical shoes and bags common in Japan
aprons and indoor slippers when relevant
signage_rules: Japanese only unless an authentic brand or device requires roman letters
forbidden_cross_locale_cues: European-only street furniture or road signs
Chinese-only packaging drift when the setting is Japan
Korean signage drift when the setting is Japan
generic Western hospital-stock imagery when the line is not clinical

age_presentation_keywords: gentle wrinkles around eyes and mouth
age_negative_keywords: DO NOT make the character look younger than 60
avoid thick dark hair unless character design requires it
demographic_anchors.gouache_age_compensation: Because gouache and watercolor naturally soften aging features, EXPLICITLY include at least 2-3 visible aging cues in every human character: wrinkles, gray/white hair, age-appropriate body language, weathered hands
